about: Answers real GitHub (api.github.com) gave this tile's live checks (live_test.go) on 2026-10-04, with a test GitHub App on one private repo. Token-free. TestFakeMatchesLiveGitHub asks the fake GitHub each question and wants the same answer.

cases.name: hook-config-webhook-off
cases.call: GET /app/hook/config (App JWT; the App's webhook is off)

cases.name: check-token-not-this-apps
cases.call: POST /applications/{client_id}/token (basic auth) for a token this App never issued (a PAT, a made-up ghu_)

cases.name: check-token-bearer-not-basic
cases.call: POST /applications/{client_id}/token with a bearer token instead of basic auth

cases.name: revoke-token-not-this-apps
cases.call: DELETE /applications/{client_id}/token (basic auth) for a token this App never issued

cases.name: revoke-grant-not-this-apps
cases.call: DELETE /applications/{client_id}/grant (basic auth) for a token this App never issued

cases.name: revoke-again-after-grant
cases.call: DELETE /applications/{client_id}/grant, then /grant and /token again (basic auth) with the access token the grant was revoked with

cases.name: check-token-after-grant
cases.call: POST /applications/{client_id}/token (basic auth) for the access token a revoked grant had

cases.name: refresh-after-grant-revoked
cases.call: POST https://github.com/login/oauth/access_token (client_id, grant_type=refresh_token, no client_secret) with the refresh token of a revoked grant (the HTTP status wasn't recorded)

cases.name: installation-token-revoke
cases.call: DELETE /installation/token with a stateless ghs_ token, then a read with it

cases.name: installation-token-revoke-again
cases.call: DELETE /installation/token with a token already revoked

cases.name: mint-answer
cases.call: POST /app/installations/{id}/access_tokens with repositories and permissions

cases.name: repo-permissions-installation-token
cases.call: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo} with an installation token

cases.name: installation-repositories-permissions
cases.call: GET /installation/repositories with an installation token (the first repo)

cases.name: pull-create-without-contents
cases.call: POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls with an installation token without contents (pull_requests, issues: write; metadata: read)

cases.name: pull-create-exists
cases.call: POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls for a head with an open pull request
cases.message: A pull request already exists for

cases.name: graphql-ready-contents-read
cases.call: POST /graphql markPullRequestReadyForReview with an installation token of pull_requests: write, contents: read

cases.name: graphql-ready-contents-write
cases.call: POST /graphql markPullRequestReadyForReview with an installation token of pull_requests and contents: write

cases.name: graphql-unknown-node
cases.call: POST /graphql markPullRequestReadyForReview for a node id that doesn't exist

cases.name: job-log-running
cases.call: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/jobs/{id}/logs while the job runs, then its Location

cases.name: job-log-completed
cases.call: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/jobs/{id}/logs for a completed job, then its Location

cases.name: conditional-get
cases.call: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{n} again with If-None-Match: its ETag
